attestation.what: Batch attestations on a public blockchain. Each one records the SHA-256 of a production batch's laboratory report, so the report can be checked against the file a buyer holds.
attestation.proves: That the laboratory report file existed at the recorded time and has not been changed since.
attestation.doesNotProve: That the product is approved for any market, and that the product is good. Approval is the market authority's decision and quality is the laboratory's.

provenance.note: This file was written and assembled with the help of an AI. Every fact in it is checked against the laboratory reports and the production records it names. Where a number has no document behind it, the file does not state it.
